narrative.overview:
The site is a painting first. On the home page a slow WebGL sky of dark petrol smoke, warm plum and rust turns behind the logo: three sigil rings, circuit traces running to the edges, embers, a hatched, inked vignette. On it sits a single, centred stage: the DF27 logo, the season lettered in brass ink, one tracked line, and the portals. Every other page stands on the same palette as a still ground (three radial gradients over ink) and opens on a centred title.

Below the stage, and on every subpage, a veil darkens the ground to near-black and the page becomes quiet centred columns: brass rubric headings between inked rules, a large ivory lead, facts and figures, square ink plates edged in faint brass, photographs in thin brass frames. The materials are few and old-world (ink, ivory, brass), and the one modern element, the cold aether light, is spent only on response: hover, focus, and the painting's own glow.
keyCharacteristics: An ink ground under a painting; text lives on the veil, not on the paint.
Ivory type in one system sans; brass for ornament, labels and figures.
The aether light (cyan) means "this responds"; it never decorates at rest.
A beveled, eight-sided brass portal is the button; one solid portal per screen.
Inked, slightly trembling strokes (the `aether-ink` tremor) on every drawn line.
Centred and symmetric; content that repeats sits on plates, not cards.

rules.name: The Cold Light Rule
rules.body: The aether colour is a response, never a resting colour: hover, focus, selected text, a field a failed submit points at, and the painting's glow only. A control at rest is ivory and brass; it turns aether when the visitor reaches it.

rules.name: The Three Materials Rule
rules.body: Ink, ivory and brass carry everything at rest. No new hue enters the page chrome; the painting's petrol, plum and rust stay inside the canvas and the body's gradients.

rules.name: The One Stack Rule
rules.body: The site loads no web font. Bebas Neue, Special Elite and JetBrains Mono belong to the 2026 system (`docs/design-2026.md`) and the archive; they are gone from the build and never return to a live page; nothing else is added either.

rules.name: The Label Voice Rule
rules.body: Small captions and headings speak in the label voice: uppercase, 600, tracked between 0.18em and 0.28em, always through `label()` (or `action()`, which calls it). Running text is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Veil Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on the bright painting. Every band is on the veil; on the home stage only the logo, the season, one label line (with a dark text shadow) and the portals sit over the paint, where the shader keeps the smoke darkest behind the logo.

rules.name: The Light Is Response Rule
rules.body: A glow is the aether light: only on the home logo (part of the painting) and on a portal in response. Nothing else glows.

rules.name: The Brass Ornament Rule
rules.body: The inked rule ending in a diamond appears in exactly two places: either side of the season mark, and either side of a rubric heading (mirrored). It is never a divider, a bullet or a background.

rules.name: The One Portal Rule
rules.body: One solid portal per screen. A form's submit (the newsletter) or a second choice (the last edition beside the stage's action) is framed. The cookie slip's Accept is the solid portal in its own fixed layer and does not count against the page.

rules.name: The Plates Not Cards Rule
rules.body: What repeats sits on square ink plates with a faint brass edge, never tilted, never shadowed, never rounded. The 2026 paper, tape strip and grease pencil do not come back (`.grease` is hidden).

dos: **Do** take every colour, size and space from the `:root` tokens in `BaseLayout.scss` and the `_aether.scss` / `_type.scss` recipes.
**Do** set every caption and heading through `label()` or `action()`, tracked 0.18–0.28em.
**Do** keep every band on the veil.
**Do** give every animation and transition a `prefers-reduced-motion` opt-out; the painting becomes one still frame.
**Do** pass every drawn stroke through the ink tremor so it reads as inked.
**Do** meet WCAG 2.2 AA; `npm run a11y` (axe) covers the live pages.
donts: **Don't** use the aether colour at rest; it is hover, focus and the painting's glow.
**Don't** put a second solid portal on a screen, or round a portal's corners.
**Don't** use the brass rule and diamond anywhere but the season mark and rubric headings.
**Don't** load a web font or bring a 2026 face (Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono) onto a live page.
**Don't** add cards, tilt, box shadows or radius; repeated content sits on flat plates.
**Don't** turn on a flagged surface still in the 2026 system.
**Don't** set text over the bright painting.
